sloka: यश्चैव शक्त्या ऽभिहतस्त्वया ऽद्य इच्छन् विषादं सहसा ऽभ्युपेतः ।स एव रक्षोगणराज मृत्युः सपुत्रदारस्य तवाद्ययुद्धे ।। ६.५९.१३३ ।।।।
transliteration: yaścaiva śaktyā 'bhihatastvayā 'dya icchan viṣādaṁ sahasā 'bhyupetaḥ ।sa eva rakṣogaṇarāja mṛtyuḥ saputradārasya tavādyayuddhe ।। 6.59.133 ।।।।

translations.english: "By me, who is your adversary, fourteen thousand Rakshasas of fierce forms, who had taken abode at Janasthana and used choicest weapons were exterminated."
